title: Serein Distribution Base Image
description: Pinned, machine-readable provenance for the upstream Ubuntu release image S7.0 remasters. This is a contract, never a live probe result - `verified` only ever becomes true after an actual sha256 (and, where present, GPG signature) check has run against the real downloaded file; it is never set true by construction.

signing_key_fingerprint.description: 40-hex-char OpenPGP v4 fingerprint of the expected signer, pinned so verify-base-image.sh never trusts an arbitrary key merely because a signature happens to be present.

verified.description: True only after this exact file (matched by sha256) has actually been checksum-verified in this environment. Never true by construction.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last real verification, or null if never verified here.
